description: Four attenuator and inverter channels whose inputs cascade into one another, so one signal can be split four ways

params.text: Attenuates that channel from silence to unity gain
Picks whether that channel passes its input as it stands or inverts it

inputs.text: The signal for that channel; with nothing patched, a channel takes the signal of the channel above it, and the topmost one takes a steady 10V

outputs.text: That channel's input, attenuated and inverted according to its own knob and switch

menu: Normalled voltage — sets what the topmost input falls back to when nothing is patched: +1V, +5V or +10V, with +10V the default
